executable.build_context: Dirty development CLI based on 2f486ad38178acfaa1a806aecb8456db7265de6d; this is a baseline commit, not a claim that the executable contains only that commit.
executable.source_binding_limit: No complete source-code inventory was frozen and independently attested for this build. The measurements bind this executable and collector only. A copied-project inventory is not source-code identity.
executable.superseded_by_later_work: This executable predates the final reference-member resource/cancellation and bound-copy repairs and subsequent draft-safety repairs. Do not transfer its timing or pass counts to later source or an installed candidate.

collector.stop_rule: Stop remaining opens after failed process, invalid receipt, output/resource limit, or changed executable. Fixed warm repetitions continue after soft timing failure; no tuning or retries.

observations.context: Fresh CLI process; newly copied and hash-checked project. Copy/hash activity may warm the OS cache; no cache eviction.
Fresh CLI process on the same copy; warmed filesystem cache expected. No in-process snapshot reuse across opens.

verification_scope.numeric_pass_definition: Each of four retained energy series is decoded and its arithmetic rederived once; sensitivity consumes the same exact verified records within that open. A final content-hash fence completes the as-of-open snapshot. Later opens verify bytes again.
verification_scope.counter_definition: Bytes-read and files-verified are service counters across verification phases; they are not unique project bytes, physical disk-I/O measurements or allocation counts.
verification_scope.memory_definition: CLI-process working set only. No simulation engine is launched by open. Working set does not measure the separate metadata-allocation budget.
verification_scope.remaining: Repeat against an identified final source/candidate, observe visible desktop feedback and cooperative cancellation within 1000 ms while preserving the previous document/pending evidence, and distinguish a controlled cache observation from these fresh-process measurements.

privacy: Only aggregate measurements and executable/collector/log identities are public. Raw paths, project/run identifiers, copied-project inventories and all private architectural identities remain external.
